notes: The drawing is a 0.5 m contour plan of the whole site with the nominated property boundary and a graticule. The site was found at the published coordinates; the castle, east reservoir and the south-west earthwork with its pond are unmistakable in the current Esri image (Vantor Vivid, 2023-12-18, 0.5 m). A first fit from cp1-cp4 was checked with an overlay: the castle walls, the north channel's tree belt and the south-west earthwork fall on the drawn contours, and cp5-cp7 were then identified on the plan and in the image. Points span about 1.4 km from the south-west pond to the east reservoir. All points are on landforms or contour edges except cp1, so most are class C. No statement of a wall's or the town's orientation was met.
